name: Long War of the Chosen
description: The Long War of the Chosen (LWOTC) total-conversion overhaul of War of the Chosen: reworked classes (Gunner, Technical, Shinobi, Assault), rebalanced research/weapons, and ruleset-specific facility costs.
attribution_text: Long War 2 Studios / Pavonis Interactive community (LWOTC project)
ingestion_notes: Authored directly from LongWarOfTheChosen/Config/XComLW_Overhaul.ini at the pinned commit (the FacilityTable, TechTable and ItemTable config arrays), plus UFOpaedia '(LWOTC)'-tagged pages for class-roster confirmation, November 2026. Facility BuildDays/Power/SupplyCost/AlloyCost/CrystalCost/CoreCost values are transcribed verbatim from FacilityTable/FacilityUpgradeTable entries in that INI file. Research prerequisite chains (PrereqTech1/2/3, RequiredScienceScore, resource costs) are transcribed verbatim from TechTable entries in the same file. This pack does NOT attempt to transcribe LWOTC's full ability-tree/combat-balance data (brief: 'build parser/adapter code only when it produces reliable, repeatable data' -- ability trees are far too large and volatile between LWOTC releases to be worth transcribing in this phase); only strategy-layer facts (facilities, research, classes, weapons) relevant to a campaign planner are included. A future refresh should re-diff against a newer source_commit_sha before re-curating. Phase 7: rank list and the LWS_Ranger/Sharpshooter/Grenadier/Specialist class replacements come from XComClassData.ini at the pinned commit (rank comments; base classes set NumInDeck=0). Rank display names expand the file's abbreviations. LWOTC's 9-rank ladder (Rookie..Master Sergeant) is authored as its own set of soldier_rank objects, not as replacements of specific vanilla ranks: the source file documents promotion order only, not a verified 1:1 mapping onto vanilla's 8 ranks, so no replacement is claimed.
